title: Every readiness and connection label says only what it checked, in one vocabulary
acceptance: The Live card music line no longer says "Music ready" or "a music service Live can play" when it has only checked for provider links.
Account Apple Music playback no longer shows "Authorized" from stored connection data alone; it says what is known and that Live checks this browser (D24).
The Live header count says what it counts.
Classes list labels name the actual gap ("2 blocks empty", "1 song outside the plan") instead of one "Needs music" for four different states, and a tempo-only gap does not read like a blocker.
Connection states and actions use one word each across Music, Account and preflight ("Session expired"/"Reconnect needed"/"Reconnect"; "Manage" vs "Manage connections").
The new vocabulary is written into the design canon; iOS follows the canon wording.
Judgment, if the owner accepts it: Classes home surfaces one next class and what is left on it.
nextAction: Waits on the RF-131 vocabulary (and tempo) decisions; can start with the D24 Account fix, which needs no decision. Files: apps/web/src/lib/readiness.ts, library-shell.ts, providers.ts, Dashboard.tsx, ConnectionStateMark.tsx, ritmofit_design_system copy. Surface: web; iOS for canon wording only.

evidence.summary: The music dimension checks only providerRefs.length; its detail text claims "Live can play", which the file header says is preflight's job. Checked on main c9b89a7.
providerCapabilityTruth labels playback "Authorized" from a stored connection with playback scope; Live checks MusicKit isAuthorized in the current browser. Checked on main c9b89a7.
readinessLabel maps four plan and music states to "Needs music"; every non-Ready label gets the same dot. Checked on main c9b89a7.
